name: Latent Vector Quantization with MLP Decoder
definition: A compression technique where per-point attributes are encoded into a quantized latent vector using an MLP decoder, allowing for efficient storage and reconstruction of Gaussian attributes.
summary: Latent Vector Quantization with MLP Decoder compresses 3D Gaussian attributes by mapping integer indices to continuous values via a lightweight decoder, avoiding the memory and speed overhead of complex probabilistic models.
